title: What belongs in a wireframe?
instruction: You are drawing a wireframe of the club’s home page. Mark what belongs in it.
debrief: A wireframe deals with what is on the page and where. Colours, fonts and real photos come later.

items.why: The position of the menu is exactly what the sketch is about.

items.text: How big the main photo is and where it sits
items.why: The place for a photo is drawn as a rectangle with a cross.

items.text: The exact shade of blue in the header
items.why: A wireframe leaves colours out on purpose.

items.text: The Sign up for the event button
items.why: A button and its place belong in the sketch.
The typeface is the look, and that comes later in CSS.
Real photos are not in the sketch, only the place where they will go.

items.text: The order of the sections on the page
items.why: What is at the top and what is at the bottom is the main question of the sketch.
